program.name: Hamstring Strong
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: The back of the legs, slowly: Romanian deadlifts, single-leg hinges and bridges with long lowering.
program.about: The back of the legs, trained slowly and well. One day is hinges, Romanian deadlifts, kettlebell deadlifts and swings; the other is single-leg work, single-leg deadlifts, bridges and split squats. Both later levels slow every rep, with a long lowering that builds strong, resilient hamstrings. Straight sets with full rests. Abs finish every session.
